domain: 20 explicit cases: three command depths, incomplete unknown/ASCII/Unicode short groups and single-flag controls, normal errors and complete/empty/separate-value controls.
classification: The independently authored corpus declares incomplete before native execution; Gooo resolves mode and pending-token intent, not tokenization or grammar validity.
derivation: Independently authored observer and intent activity. No upstream parser implementation is copied into Gooo.
exclusions: arbitrary flags, token sequences or command graphs
